question: In October 2024, India and Pakistan agreed to extend the Kartarpur Corridor agreement for how many additional years?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**5 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kartarpur Corridor** is a landmark initiative between **India** and **Pakistan** to facilitate Sikh pilgrims' travel to the holy site of **Gurdwara Darbar Sahib**, Kartarpur, in Pakistan.
 
• It connects **Dera Baba Nanak** in the Gurdaspur district of Punjab, India, to **Kartarpur Sahib** in Pakistan.
 
• In **October 2024**, both nations agreed to extend the agreement for an additional **5 years**, showing mutual cooperation and respect for religious sentiments.
 
• The corridor was originally inaugurated on **9th November 2019**, marking the 550th birth anniversary of **Guru Nanak Dev Ji**.
 
• The agreement allows Sikh pilgrims to visit the site without a visa, provided they obtain a permit.
 
• The extension reflects the corridor's significance in fostering **peaceful relations** and promoting **cultural diplomacy** between the two nations.
 
• The Gurdwara Kartarpur Sahib is where Guru Nanak Dev Ji spent the last years of his life, making it one of the most revered places for Sikhs.
 
• The corridor is a symbol of **cross-border religious harmony**, and its extension for 5 years ensures continued access for pilgrims to this holy site.
